static_checks.reason: Q rejects bool and binary floats, parses bounded signed integer/decimal/rational strings exactly, rejects zero denominator/nonfinite syntax, and bounds decimal exponent. Degree/bits/state-size use exact built-in integer validation.

floor_scaled and ceil_scaled implement mathematical floor/ceiling with positive dyadic scale. Repeated positive squaring floors the lower and ceils the upper; clipping upper at1 uses an independent global bound.

Range reduction gives y<=1/2. Stopping on an odd Taylor degree retains that odd lower and the previous even upper. Positive exact terms, m>=1 positivity, degree bound and final dyadic squaring match the theorem.

SI constants are exact Fractions, decimal level literals remain exact, reference energy is minimal, degeneracies/T are positive; coordinate extrema use own lower/other upper and own upper/other lower. Strict positive weight lower guards prevent invalid normalization.

Source and reused parser hashes are checked before import/parse; parser enforces ordered IDs and exact source pairs/temperatures. Direct pair ratio avoids normalized-box dependency division. Only selected100K para-H2 graph is constructed.
Offdiagonal bounds are nonnegative/ordered; lower diagonal is minus upper exit and upper diagonal is minus lower exit. Caller-supplied nonzero placeholder diagonals are refused.
reset_generator_bounds checks simplex intersection and v_lower>=kappa, constructs full offdiagonal K+pi(v-kappa)^T and recalculates diagonal exits. No K-only rho substitution is made by the runner.
lambda uses the full generator's upper exits, rejects undersized explicit rates, falls back to positive1 for zero generator, and checks nonnegative substochastic Pminus.

Each nonnegative integer dot product is floored after dividing by scale. Right multiplication of the rounded lower power by rounded Pminus still inductively lower-bounds Pminus^m; no commutativity of time-varying A is assumed.

Initial weight is a lower exp(-mu), recursion floors w_m*mu/(m+1). Every product/sum stays below the positive series. Exact integer min-pair overlap gives beta_lower and rho_upper=1-beta_lower; column mass is checked.
n=1 deliberately assigns beta1/rho0 for the trivial zero-sum subspace, not as a claim that a finite truncated scalar propagator has unit mass. n>1 zero generator has zero pair overlap.

Chunked integer parser/formatter avoid Python's4300-digit decimal conversion limit without changing the global setting. Fraction outputs become exact strings. Independent reference uses its own parser; extremely large generic reference strings beyond its integer limit are not established by this review.

forced_step enforces nonnegative bounds and rho in[0,1], applies common kappa once to the residual endpoint, uses G=q(M+FH)+g and area HU+GH^2/2 for E. Whole-block values remain independent of contracted endpoints.
Exact K conservation/simplex/positivity, c=Kpi-v*pi+pi*vbar, Qf=f-piF, min(v),vbar,osc(v)/2 match the admitted finite constant model.

Four native blocks fit n/N/bits/mu caps; three explicit mathematical forced controls and one positive two-piece switching fixture are declared. Output is create-only, hashes input/core/runner and preserves exceptions/failures; actual passes cannot be inferred statically.

No production import; separate source parser and Decimal250 transcendental calculations, ordered SciPy propagators, full-A killing identity and augmented forced system. Tolerances and unresolved narrow-interval status are explicit; numerical samples do not replace the general proof.

58CPU-second internal interrupt and60-second resource flag are prepared. The measured flag at finalize is separate from numerical PASS; root must retain resource failures/overruns and final wrapper timing rather than infer success from exit alone.

conditional_API_boundaries: Validity of caller-supplied interval-wide coefficient bounds is a theorem precondition; forced_step does not independently validate a physical provider.

Coordinate probability boxes retain an underlying simplex/Gibbs dependency; arbitrary box corners are not asserted to be simultaneously physical.
Source literal precision is not source measurement uncertainty. Physical destruction and consumer remain UNBOUND.
Static acceptance is readiness for the contracted first run after required publication stage, not final scientific C9.
